title: Secret Universe
creator: vocational

blocks.v:
Most of the puzzles are highly creative and entertaining; however, the hints for some of them are extremely difficult to spot.
This game has been revolutionary for the "puzzle" genre on Roblox, and the majority of popular puzzle games currently available draw their inspiration from it.
